author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the LEGO scandal involving Bricks and Minifigs reaching a point where it's not just a national story but the journalist/youtuber who broke it is now being gagged allegedly leaving the topic to the rest of the community. title: Bricks And Minifigs Is Way Worse Than I Thought...
